title: Shared-element container morph
blurb: Four live HTML grid cards drawn on one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas that melt from any clicked slot into an expanded detail sheet through a continuous sdRoundBox SDF mask, cross-blur and updateElementGeometry() hit-test handoff.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas melt any of four live HTML grid cards continuously into an expanded detail sheet and back into its slot using a rounded-rect SDF mask, cross-blur UV scaling and updateElementGeometry() hit testing?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27): 6/6 live checks pass on ElementGL (1.04 MP, 8.3 MB at 412 px DPR 2.625, 0 lost contexts) and under ?route=2d (draws.wrong === 0), keeping grid cards clickable at 0% and #mc-detail controls live at 100%. Real Android hardware and npm run check:jank stay not verified.
